{{Top|leg}}
The '''Environment shield level 1''' was designed to resist the harsh conditions of factory floors. This [[droid shield]] provided a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with basic protection against a broad array of environmental effects. Unfortunately, the power drain during its use was significant, therefore, the units needed to be replaced regularly. It was installed in the wreckage of a [[Rakatan guardian droid]] in the [[Rakatan ruins (Dantooine)|Rakatan ruins]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
